user.title: Create a PID controller
user.description: The controller reads the source entity and calculates an output that drives it towards the set point. The set point, gains and limits become entities of the controller, so they can be changed at any time and from automations.

data_description.name: Also used for the entity ID of the output sensor.
data_description.source: The measured value, for example a temperature or PM2.5 sensor.
data_description.unit_of_measurement: Optional unit of the output, for example % or level.

initial_values.name: Initial values
initial_values.description: Starting values of the controller entities. You can change them later on the device page.

deprecated_yaml.title: PID controller "{name}" was imported from YAML

deprecated_yaml_exists.title: PID controller "{name}" is still configured in YAML
deprecated_yaml_exists.description:
A PID controller named "{name}" already exists in the UI, so its YAML configuration was not imported again.

Remove the `platform: pid_controller` entry from your YAML configuration and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
